pull_request.body:
Bumps the dependencies group with 3 updates: [Kesin11/actions-timeline](https://github.com/kesin11/actions-timeline), [github/gh-aw-actions/setup](https://github.com/github/gh-aw-actions) and [github/gh-aw-actions/setup-cli](https://github.com/github/gh-aw-actions). Updates `Kesin11/actions-timeline` from 3.1.0 to 3.2.0
Release notes

Sourced from Kesin11/actions-timeline's releases.

v3.2.0

v3.2.0

Changes

Support new parallel syntax.

Similar to composite action expansion, an overall parent span is created for steps executed in parallel. Child span names for steps running in parallel in the background are prefixed with (bg).

Sample screenshot: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d92027fc-ded2-4b6e-9ab0-e3923b698ec3

Features

  • timeline: Render parallel steps concurrently @​Kesin11 (#362)

Fixes

  • composite: Skip synthetic parallel parents @​Kesin11 (#363)

Dependencies

  • chore(deps): update node.js to v24.18.1 @renovate[bot] (#361)
  • chore(deps): update dependency deno to v2.9.4 @renovate[bot] (#360)
  • chore(deps): update jdx/mise-action action to v4.2.3 @renovate[bot] (#357)
  • chore(deps): update dependency deno to v2.9.3 @renovate[bot] (#356)
  • chore(deps): update actions/setup-node action to v7 @renovate[bot] (#355)
  • chore(deps): update auto merge major github-actions @renovate[bot] (#354)
  • chore(deps): update dependency deno to v2.9.2 @renovate[bot] (#353)
  • chore(deps): update dependency deno to v2.9.1 @renovate[bot] (#352)
  • chore(deps): update dependency deno to v2.9.0 @renovate[bot] (#351)
  • chore(deps): update dependency @​std/collections to ^1.3.0 @renovate[bot] (#350)
  • chore(deps): update dependency @​std/yaml to ^1.1.2 @renovate[bot] (#349)
  • chore(deps): update dependency @​std/encoding to ^1.0.11 @renovate[bot] (#348)
  • chore(deps): update node.js to v24 @renovate[bot] (#346)

Internal improvement

  • Fix GitHub App token creation in rebundle workflow @​Kesin11 (#359)
  • Using new parallel syntax for dogfooding @​Kesin11 (#358)
  • fix: migrate release-drafter.yml to v7 config schema @​Kesin11 (#347)

v3.1.1

v3.1.1

Changes

  • b387c7a Skip parallel parents during composite matching
  • 74e45cd timeline: Render parallel steps concurrently (#362)
  • 845b827 Ignore parent-like names inside parallel groups
  • e503bd9 Update sample screenshot
  • f76d69a Derive parallel children from log markers
  • 6a2cd4e Omit too detailed description
  • 375498b Avoid parallel and composite name collisions
  • 097feef Model composite actions inside parallel steps
  • 51d502d Preserve source names for parallel children
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view
